'''Gren Olpan''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] being who lived on [[Cato Neimoidia/Legends|Cato Neimoidia]] during the time of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was the son of [[Sanna Olpan]].<ref name="CotG" />

During the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] occupation of Cato Neimoidia, Olpan was arrested by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Suljo Warde]] on charges of plotting against the Republic.<ref name="CotG" />
